source.inspection: Original PNG opened individually once, before reading the modern template or any authored figure spec.

observations.description: One continuous projected construction, not separate panels. S is the top apex; C is lower left, B lower right, and A lies above the projected CB edge, near the dashed middle ray. All four point labels are printed; there are no isolated point dots.

A solid outer plane-like frame runs C to a left upper shoulder, then S, then a right upper shoulder, then B; the lower CB boundary closes the frame. SC and SB are interior solid rays within that same frame. The frame is not a rectangle, separate card, or labelled additional solid.

SC, SB, and CB are solid. SA is dashed from the apex to A; AC and AB are dashed from A to their respective base endpoints. These three dashed edges remain attached at the same A. Ink wobble does not establish curved edges.

All angle marks share vertex S. A single inner arc marks the left sector between SC and SA, labelled beta. A single inner arc marks the right sector between SA and SB, with a gamma-like Greek label. A larger double arc spans SC to SB across SA, labelled alpha. The three symbols name sectors, not edge lengths.

trueAmbiguities.observation: The right-sector glyph is gamma-like but its thick scan can resemble delta. Pixel inspection alone is insufficient to fix its modern character.

trueAmbiguities.observation: The pixels show a 3D projection but supply no numerical angle or length values and no right-angle or equal-length marks. Exact spatial metric relations cannot be inferred from the projected slopes.
The frame and CB line are irregular from source printing/scanning. Their exact pixel curvature is not a stated mathematical condition.
